components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-priority actions such as Submit Submittal, Approve Drawing, or Save Project.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #18181b; color: #fafafa; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #09090b; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #71717a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary actions like Filter, Export, or Cancel.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #09090b; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f4f4f5; }

components.name: Status Badge Approved
components.css: .ds-badge-approved { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; border: 1px solid #bbf7d0; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; }

components.name: Status Badge Expired
components.description: Permit or NOC expired status badge requiring immediate revalidation.
components.css: .ds-badge-expired { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; background: #fee2e2; color: #991b1b; border: 1px solid #fecaca; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Standard form text input for reference numbers, project names, and dates.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #ffffff; color: #09090b; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #18181b; outline-offset: 1px; border-color: #18181b; }

narrative.overview: The Engineering Command Deck is a utilitarian, high-density operational surface built for engineers, document controllers, and managers managing complex multi-authority construction approvals across Dubai. Every screen prioritizes legibility, state immediacy, and rigorous data structure over ornamentation.
keyCharacteristics: High-Density Utility: Compact data grids and tabular layouts presenting deep metadata without horizontal scrolling waste.
Strict Structural Boundaries: 1px hairline borders define panels and grid cells instead of floating drop shadows.
Immediate Status Visibility: Authority NOC states communicate urgency with high-contrast badge tokens.
Fast, Predictable Motion: Transitions are instant or capped at 150ms.

rules.name: The High-Contrast Status Rule
rules.body: Color is reserved exclusively for system state, review outcomes, and compliance urgency. Colored text or backgrounds for purely decorative purposes are prohibited.

rules.name: The Restrained Surface Rule
rules.body: The primary dark slate accent must occupy no more than 10% of any view, ensuring primary calls to action retain undisputed visual priority.

rules.name: The Fixed-Density Scale Rule
rules.body: Fluid typography clamps are prohibited in core data tables and toolbars. Type sizes are fixed across viewports to maintain deterministic data alignment.

rules.name: The Monospace Reference Rule
rules.body: All project codes, drawing revision numbers, and authority permit IDs must render in monospace font tokens to guarantee scannability.

rules.name: The Structural Border Rule
rules.body: Never use drop shadows to demarcate cards or data panels. Every container boundary must be established with a solid 1px border.

rules.name: The Ghost Card Prohibition
rules.body: Never combine a 1px border with a diffuse drop shadow (blur > 8px) on interactive elements.

dos: Do use strict 1px borders (#e4e4e7) to separate data sections, table cells, and panel modules.
Do display project codes (e.g. 23016), drawing revisions (R00, R01), and authority reference IDs in monospace font tokens.
Do ensure all text hits at least 4.5:1 contrast against its background for outdoor on-site readability.
Do enforce instant feedback (≤150ms transitions) on state changes, approvals, and filter selections.
Do show explicit delay counters (e.g. '4 days delayed') and expiry countdowns in prominent warning badges.
donts: Don't use oversized rounded cards (border-radius > 16px) or puffy pill containers.
Don't use decorative gradient text (background-clip: text with gradient fills) anywhere in the application.
Don't add decorative illustrations, doodle SVGs, or marketing hero graphics to technical workflows.
Don't waste vertical screen real estate with bloated padding or arbitrary spacing gaps.
Don't reproduce legacy ERP spaghetti: avoid unstyled HTML tables, unformatted timestamps, and hidden menus.
Don't use casual pastel badges or low-contrast muted gray text for critical authority statuses.
Don't implement slow multi-step page entrance animations or delayed transitions that interrupt technical workflows.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px) as alert markers on table rows or list items.
